quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn right. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending soon. Prepare to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to allow these vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road curves right first, then left. Slow down and watch for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from this direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign shows that the road splits. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Posted a few hundred feet before the tracks, this sign tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They tell you about upcoming road hazards. This sign means a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to situations ahead. This sign tells you a side road will cross ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is under repair or maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is under repair or maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction and maintenance signs are orange. They warn drivers about unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully because construction work is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road ahead go first before you enter or cross.
Keep a steady speed and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road ahead go first before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, cyclist, or pedestrian pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of construction, maintenance, or road work. These signs help drivers and pedestrians stay safe in these areas. Traffic fines may be doubled in these zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted. You often see this sign at intersections where U-turns are dangerous because of oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that all drivers must follow. Right turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and vehicles coming from other directions. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Pay attention when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way traffic road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely around these curves.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
You may turn right on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two one-way sections separated by a median. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or travel beside traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at exactly this speed.
The maximum speed allowed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed allowed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or unsafe conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns on red are allowed with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location. Making a right turn here would be unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers they are entering a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to curves ahead. Be ready to slow down and steer carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this warning sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a winding road. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be ready for it.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road curves sharply ahead.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road curves sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down as you would at an intersection turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: About conditions on or near the road.
How to reach cities and towns ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: About conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs with black markings on yellow background are warning signs. They tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows in one direction only.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers, such as rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
This lane is for buses and carpool vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road is entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before you cross.
Always stop completely at this intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: A driver's left arm points straight down. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points down, they are signaling they will stop. Adjust your driving if the car ahead of you uses this signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs warn of a sharp curve. The arrow shows the direction of the curve. Multiple chevron signs may mark the entire curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane ends or the road narrows.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to areas where animals, people, or bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or steep hill is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road has low clearance above it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right first, then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign shows that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead becomes divided by a median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Leave extra space so drivers can safely merge into traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Keep to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Leave extra space so drivers can safely merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and diamond-shaped. They warn you about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming down ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you pedestrians may cross here. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and wait until they have fully crossed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a lane is closing ahead and you need to move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road is slippery when wet. Slow down when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pentagon-shaped sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and obey the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not be able to pass a truck safely on it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A circular sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are three or more curves coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter a ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means there is a railroad crossing coming up.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing in front of you.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing in front of you.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. At a stop sign, you must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Wait until the intersection is clear before moving forward.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions because vehicles are harder to control.

questions.question: If you approach a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat it like a stop sign.
Cannot move until it turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Let other traffic and pedestrians cross before you move.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must bear to the right or to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing area ahead. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign indicates that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then curves to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: This road sign indicates:

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for exiting a highway.
The maximum safe speed for entering a highway.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for exiting a highway.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed is 55 mph under normal conditions.
You cannot drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 55 mph under normal conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for that road. You can drive slower than the posted limit based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on a green light must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on a green light must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells left-turning drivers they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules that drivers must obey. This sign means no passing is allowed for any reason.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can choose to continue or exit the freeway from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane will exit the road. You can either change lanes to continue on the freeway or you must exit if you stay in that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At this crossing, slow down and check carefully for trains. Look both ways, listen closely, and be prepared to stop. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign. It tells drivers they cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead ends at an intersection. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep going at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead and you should be ready to stop at a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let oncoming traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let oncoming traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross your path before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive safely, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down means you must yield. Slow down when you see this sign. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign shows the safe speed for the upcoming curve. Slow down to 35 mph or less.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a person is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at this location.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in rain or wet conditions.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left. Slow down for these sharp turns.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. Do not turn left at this location.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about road conditions. This sign means the road will curve sharply right and then sharply left. Reduce speed for these turns.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where people cross the road. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about work zones. When you see orange signs, stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is coming. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting. You should stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you about wet pavement where you could lose control. Slow down when the road is wet because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are forbidden.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows you the only direction traffic can go on this street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a freeway with two or more lanes, make room for traffic entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill coming. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Turning left at this intersection is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are good. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road changes direction or gets narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disability license plates or placards.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to danger ahead. This sign tells you to slow down because the road will turn sharply.

questions.question: What should concern you most when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or turn the wheel sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance sign. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the road is clear.
You must come to a complete stop before going forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. You could crash head-on with another vehicle. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are following this driver, adjust your driving for their turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Certain turns are allowed only from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign warns you that the separated highway is ending and two-way traffic is starting.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no right turns. This action is not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. Slow down or stop if needed when you see this sign.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A pentagon-shaped sign means a school zone or school crossing is ahead. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a roundabout ahead. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is entering the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead to the right.
Hiking trails ahead to the right.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down. Do not use your brakes.
Slow down. Road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. Road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey them. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming and they should prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns drivers about a curve to the right.
